Five required checks before accepting a flight service request

01 • Current published AIPObtain authoritative current extra + AIRAC amendments and identify the applicable airport edition.
02 • Active SUP & NOTAMCheck validity, replacement and exact affected runway, stand, service and time.
03 • Exact field interpretationRead the original wording and approved chart where needed. Resolve all conditions and exceptions.
04 • Company service evidenceCheck contract, licensed provider, GSE, staffing, training, approvals, supply and timing.
05 • Accountable approvalRecord the responsible operations/airport authority decision for the actual flight. No automatic green clearance.
